volcengine-landing-zone 1.0.3

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and references/preflight-checks.md for improved clarity and alignment with current behaviors.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to skill logic or user interaction; this update focuses purely on content maintenance and cleanup.

- Added new blueprint and example files for account factory network cross-account connectivity.
- Updated core references, guidebooks, and baseline schemas to reflect new baseline structure and guidance.
- Improved file path and credential setup instructions in documentation, tightening safety/routing wording.
- Removed outdated modules and redundant skill card documentation.
- Incremented version to 1.8.1 for documentation and structure improvements.

volcengine-landing-zone 1.0.1

- Removed documentation files: TESTING.md and skill-card.md.
- No changes to the skill’s functional logic or documented usage.
- Skill functionality and user flow remain unchanged.

volcengine-landing-zone 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for consulting, designing, setting up, and managing Volcengine Landing Zones.
- Supports organization, account, finance, identity, audit, and network foundation tasks.
- Features intent-based entry routing for main Landing Zone scenarios.
- Introduces strict file display protocol for all user-facing files, requiring opening before summarization or fallback.
- Implements mandatory confirmation gates to prevent unintended execution before user review and approval.
